resources.string: The Tesla browser probably cannot open this address. Turn on the extra hotspot address below.
No hotspot found. Turn on this phone’s hotspot.
Needs root. Adds %1$s to this phone’s hotspot so the Tesla browser can reach TiPlay, and adds it again after the hotspot restarts. Applies at once; no reconnect needed.
An address in 100.64.0.0/10, the range the Tesla browser opens. Applies at once.
Enter an address in 100.64.0.0/10, for example 100.109.220.253.
TiPlay did not get root access, so the extra address stays off. Allow TiPlay in your root manager, such as Magisk, and turn it on again.
Root access was refused, so TiPlay stopped trying. Turn the setting off and on to try again.
Could not add the address. TiPlay tries again shortly.
Paused. TiPlay adds the address again when it opens or connects.
Works only when the connection uses “%1$s”.
